notes.title: SeaBed Complete Collection Now on PC!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/eab71e87a2549d971e5485ea023a4ba8c99031fe.png[/img]
The wait is over! SeaBed Complete Collection is now available on PC!

The game has been updated to Unity engine with many technical improvements, as well as support for Korean and Simplified and Traditional Chinese languages!

The game now includes the new, previously switch-exclusive bonus scenes. Moreover, a new in-game Audio Novel player has been added to the main menu.

[i]The new version will automatically inherit the game progress from existing saves.[/i]

If you'd like to play the old PC version, it has been moved to a new "Legacy" Steam branch. You can go to the game's properties -> Betas -> select "legacy" from the "beta participation" list to switch to it.

Moreover, SeaBed Complete Collection is currently -30% off during the Tokyo Game Show sale.

We hope you will enjoy the definitive SeaBed version, and it can reach even more people around the world!

notes.title: SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Now Complete!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/3ad45c34b6841884660a53fd462a64f9552046bf.jpg[/img]
Thank you for the wait! We're happy to announce that the SeaBed Audio Novel Collection is now complete with the release of Episode 3 "Silvergrass Station Cleaning"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184982/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_3__Silvergrass_Station_Cleaning/

[i]An unexpected visitor. A car ride. A quiet station.[/i]

[h2]Starring[/h2]
[list][*]    Mizuno Sachiko (Narrator & High Schooler): Kondo Yui
[*]    Takako: Matsui Eriko
[*]    Izuhana Midori: Aiya Saki
[*]    Weather Report, Coffee Shop Owner: Tokiwa Shouhei[/list]

We hope you have been enjoying the journey with the teenage goofball Takako and her handler, Sachiko!

Finally, an original short story [b]"Night Flight"[/b] by [b]Paleontology [/b]is now available as a free Extra Episode to owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28481/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection/]SeaBed Audio Novel Collection[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184983/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Extra_Episode__Night_Flight

[i]The beginning of a journey. Private tutoring. Arrival.[/i]

[h2]Starring[/h2]
[list][*]    Kotani Fujika: Shioiri Asuka
[*]    Sakura Aoi: Kita Natsuki 
[*]    Coffee Shop Waitress: Maruyama Miki[/list]

All 4 episodes in the Audio Novel Collection have been written and directed by [b]Paleontology[/b], and beautifully illustrated by [b]Tonbu[/b].

Thank you for joining us on this journey and showing so much love for the game that it allowed us to produce these new scenarios together with [b]Paleontology[/b].

notes.title: Audio Novel Episode 2 ~Cafe and the Stone Port~ Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/c3e0afe4e45915d62b42c3ece5f6d5651bfd8945.png[/img]
Thank you for waiting! SeaBed Audio Novel Collection - Episode 2: "Cafe and the Stone Port" is now available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184981/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_2__Cafe_and_the_Stone_Port/

[i]A Peaceful café. Photo album. Where to live.[/i]

The episodes are delivered in both a subtitled video format, and a Japanese audio-only track in .wav format.

With the release of Episode 2, we have also published a new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28481/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection/]Audio Novel Collection bundle[/url], which will give an additional -10% discount when buying all the episodes. It can be purchased even if you already own individual episodes.

We also have an update on the remaining episodes' release schedule!

Episode 3 "Silvergrass Station Cleaning" and the Extra Episode will be released simultaneously. Due to the extra time preparing 2 episodes at once takes, these final episodes are expected to release mid-August! 

The Extra Episode will be released as a free bonus, but is only available to owners of the upcoming SeaBed Audio Novel Collection bundle. 🙇‍♀️

We hope you will enjoy spending more time with the memorable characters of SeaBed!

notes.title: SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Episode 1 Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/50e14bf77e292f953df9380827a76ecb51f99679.jpg[/img]

Thank you all SeaBed fans for your continued support over the years! It's made it possible for us to create something new again! We're now happy to announce a project where we were able to give voice to the game's beloved characters in an all-new story...

[h3]SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Episode 1 - "Brick Incinerator" is here![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184980/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_1__Brick_Incinerator/
This Audio Novel Collection is a series of newly written audio novels for the beloved yuri-themed mystery visual novel.

Episode 1 contains:
[i]Meeting at the school. A strange incident. A scary story.[/i] (Length: 13:15)

The episodes are delivered in both a subtitled video format, and a Japanese audio-only track in .wav format.

The video supports Japanese, Japanese (closed captions), English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean subtitles which can be switched at will.

The new Audio Novel scenarios are written by [b]hide38 [/b]and directed by [b]AKIRA[/b], with beautiful key illustrations by [b]Tonbu[/b].

[h2]Starring[/h2]
[b]Sachiko [/b]has been given a cool and subtle voice by [b]Kondo Yui[/b], known as Biwa Hayahide in Uma Musume, Kiba Mikoto in Triage X, and Nath in 100% Orange Juice!

Meanwhile [b]Takako's [/b]silly antics are brought to life by [b]Matsui Eriko[/b] (Fuji Kiseki in Uma Musume, Maki Kyouko in Houkago Saikoro Club, Kokuyou in Tsugu Tsugumomo, Kamiya Nao in The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls)!

English Translation: [b]Andrew Hodgson[/b]
Chinese Translation: [b]Windyshine[/b]
Korean Translation: [b]Moonbi[/b]
    
The other 2 episodes + Extra episode of the collection will be released one by one over the coming months! 

We hope you can all enter into a wonderful year 2023 with this release!

notes.title: SeaBed coming to Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2lsmBk2I--E;full][/previewyoutube]
We have some exciting news to share from Tokyo Game Show 2019! SeaBed is heading to Nintendo Switch as well, coming to all regions this winter!

Fans of the game will be able to experience the mystery in a more portable format, and we hope many new players will also discover this gem of a story through this release.

SeaBed has been rated for Nintendo Switch as CERO-C, ESRB-T and PEGI-12.

You can follow the [url=https://fruitbatfactory.com/seabed/]game's homepage[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/fruitbatfactory]Discord server[/url] for more news.

notes.title: Dive into SeaBed
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27773285/70db92adca4bd80e409d12f9e151ac9968a551cf.jpg[/img]
The wait is over - Paleontology's masterful visual novel [b]SeaBed[/b] is now here.

Join three women: Sachiko, Takako and Narasaki, and the people whose lives they cross, as they strive to find a place for themselves and to make sense of their lives in this unique yuri-themed psychological mystery.

This release has been upgraded to support enhanced 1440x1080 resolution graphics, and includes English and Japanese languages that can be swapped at will.

Take your time. We hope you will enjoy your stay.

A playable demo is now out for SeaBed! 
Just navigate to the store page and click on "Download Demo" button to install it.

The world of SeaBed awaits you!
